result.notes: Close has a mature documented REST API (developer.close.com) supporting both HTTP Basic auth with an API key (created self-serve in Settings > Developer > API Keys) and OAuth 2.0 for user-facing integrations. Free trial (14 days, no credit card) lets developers get an API key immediately, then requires a paid plan (Solo $9/user/mo and up) to continue; API access is listed as included on all paid tiers. Close also publishes an official first-party MCP server (https://mcp.close.com/mcp) supporting both OAuth 2.0 DCR and API-key-based headers (Close-API-Key / Close-Scope), explicitly positioned for Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor agent integrations. Endpoint count not explicitly enumerated in fetched pages (docs pointed to llms.txt for full index); estimated medium breadth based on the number of distinct CRM resources (leads, contacts, opportunities, tasks, activities, custom fields, sequences, bulk actions, webhooks, smart views, reporting).
result.one_liner: Close is a sales-focused CRM (calling, email, SMS, pipelines) built for inside sales teams.
